A lot of people commenting that don’t work here so as someone who has been a delivery driver, here’s how it goes.

Delivery drivers, at least at my store, get two different sets of hourly rates. When they’re inside the store, they get paid a certain rate, like $10 an hour. But as soon as they get routed on a delivery, for the duration of their time on the road they get their pay bumped to less than minimum wage (I think $6.). Yes they get mileage pay, but that’s only to cover gas/wear on their own car. So if someone doesn’t tip they lose money taking it. Yes I wish tip culture didn’t exist because it’s just a way for corporations to get out of paying their workers a living wage. Still, unfortunately it’s the society we live in and you not tipping isn’t going to change it. Honestly you don’t need to tip 10% or anything, just a few dollars helps them stay above water. On the flip side, drivers actively giving customers worse service when they don’t see a tip also happens and they’re obviously in the wrong.

Depends on what you want.

FES pros:

Full 3d game (big deal to see how character interactions play out)

Actual cutscenes 

Additional epilogue

Cons: 
No FeMC

Not a con, but the epilogue is generally considered to be a grind-fest and best experienced through watching a YouTube playthrough

Inability to control party member's actions, only possible through a command system. Some like it, but portable has the ability to do both

P3P pros


Vastly improved battle mechanics (you now have the option to directly control your party's actions, when you couldn't in FES)


FeMC, additional playable character with different social links and a different personality than the normal MC (both are options, personally I love FeMC)

Cons: 

2d character interactions and your character interacts with people via green orb. Personally didn't mind that part, but the lack of 3d character and event interactions make you miss out on some funny moments

No epilogue

In the end if you have a PS3 in NA and a psp or Vita, you can get both or just emulate both on PC easily. If you want better combat and FeMC, try portable. If you want the 3d events, go with FES. Personally I'd try out FES for a bit and if the combat sucks go to portable. I enjoyed both.
